name: ThrowHeave
_intent: Anime overhead two-hand hurl of a big bowl kept LEVEL until it leaves the hands (a football throw-in with power): from the overhead carry, arch back and sink with the bowl drawn back behind the head (held), then drive forward through the hips with a step of the left foot and hurl it, both arms extended forward and up at the release, rear heel driving up; the arms swing down through, held bent over, then the left foot steps back and he settles to a stand.
_reference: football throw-in / overhead two-hand pass; release at frame 23 like Throw

keyframes._note: DEEPEST: arched back, sunk, bowl back behind the head
RELEASE: arms extended forward and up
